packageRules.description: eslint 10 is not installable yet: eslint-plugin-react and eslint-plugin-import peer ranges top out at eslint ^9. Re-evaluate when they publish eslint 10 support.

jsdom 27+ drops the space between sibling text nodes in accessible-name computation (jsdom#4091), breaking PatternFly alert heading queries that match real browsers. Stay on 26.x until that is fixed upstream.
TypeScript 7 is the new compiler generation and requires a dedicated migration (typescript-eslint and @types/node resolution do not support it yet). The stack is deliberately pinned to 5.9.x.
@bufbuild/protobuf is pinned to the version the generated code in @osac/types was produced with (2.12.0 runtime baseline); advancing it requires regenerating libs/types via pnpm gen-types.

Ansible collections in osac-aap/collections/requirements.yml are re-vendored by hand: updates need Automation Hub credentials, a vendor/ refresh, and integration runs. Track them in dedicated PRs instead.

Keycloak 26.7+ changes the audience claim of service-account JWTs, which OpenBao JWT auth (bound_audiences) rejects - tenant reconciliation never completes (verified on a fresh Kind install). Hold at 26.6.x until the OpenBao auth config is adapted.
